title: Prime-factor expansion of the totient divisor sum
statement: For every nonzero natural number N, let P be its finite set of prime divisors and let a_p be the exponent of p in N. Then ModularCurve.cuspCount N, defined as ∑_{d∣N} φ(gcd(d,N/d)), equals ∏_{p∈P} ∑_{j=0}^{a_p} φ(p^{min(j,a_p−j)}). The empty product for N = 1 is 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ModularCurve.cuspCount N = N.primeFactors.prod (fun p => (Finset.range (N.factorization p + 1)).sum (fun j => Nat.totient (p ^ min j (N.factorization p - j))))
